route: No independent-means route. The Police and Border Guard Board (PPA) lists residence permits for study, employment, family member, business and permanent resident only. The nearest routes are settling with a spouse who lives in Estonia, or business. Every temporary permit needs legal income and health insurance: for a permanent-resident permit 'You have a health insurance contract, confirmed by signing the application. The requirements for the health insurance contract are set out in § 120 of the Aliens Act (insurance coverage).' The PPA student guide says a private policy or Health Insurance Act cover 'needs to cover the entire period of validity'. Text of s.120 itself not retrieved (Riigi Teataja needs JavaScript).
policy: Once the couple are in the population register and have no other cover, each can sign Tervisekassa (Estonian Health Insurance Fund) voluntary health insurance: one-year contract, no health test, full Fund benefits except sickness-leave benefit, co-payments not reimbursed, cover starts one month after signing. Premium is the previous year's average gross monthly wage x 0.13. Before the first permit the couple would need a private policy; no Estonian tariff was reachable (ERGO calculator is JavaScript only).
working: Annual premium 3,264.00 EUR per person = 272.00 EUR a month (3,264 / 12). Couple: 2 x 272.00 = 544.00 EUR a month, 6,528 EUR a year. Monthly payment is just the annual cost in instalments.

eu_citizen_difference: Not sourced. I expect EU citizens need no permit and can buy the same Tervisekassa contract, but I did not retrieve a page saying so.
spot_check: Searches showed third-party sites quoting 272 EUR from July 2026 and the earlier 2026 Tervisekassa page 257.50 EUR; the live Tervisekassa page (updated 03.11.26) says 272.00. Not independently confirmed elsewhere.
uncertainty: No route exists for non-working independent-means couples, so 544 EUR is what residents without other cover pay, not a visa cost. Before the permit a private policy is needed and I found no published tariff. Premium changes each year with the average wage. Wording of Aliens Act s.120 not retrieved.

statutory_must_pay.what: Nothing compulsory. Tervisekassa voluntary insurance (EUR 544 a month for two, in the file's `amount`) is optional, so it is left out; see addendum.

private_plan.insurer: ERGO, If, Swedbank, SEB (named as popular local insurers; no tariff reached)
private_plan.terms: Indicative local plans: mostly Estonia or Schengen only, age limits, pre-existing conditions excluded. In- and out-patient split, deductible and co-payments not stated.
private_plan.pricing: Source's sample row for a 45-year-old on a permit: EUR 60-120 a month (page says 'single person or couple'; read as per person); midpoint EUR 90 x 2 = EUR 180. Same page gives a general range EUR 40-150. Indicative, unsourced by the broker.
